title: Hearty Homemade Greek Beef Stifado
description: A sweet and cozy Greek dish featuring perilla-seed-deulkkae, this stifado is perfect for a cold winter night, with a cheese-pull that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the perilla-seed-deulkkae, tomato paste, red wine, and beef broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
To keep the dish warm, place the pot in a bain-marie.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
